text:
Lena (CS): Hi team  kickoff for HarborCare onboarding. Need to align owners, minimal success criteria, and any renewal/compliance risks. Can we do a 20-30m sync tomorrow?

Diego (Solutions): I can join. Heads up: HarborCare uses SCIM + SSO via Okta, and they have a segmented network for dev vs prod. We'll want a staging API key that expires.

Priyanka (PM): Proposed success criteria: 1) simple ingest & inference end-to-end within 72h, 2) linted prompt set with >=75% pass on semantic QA, 3) cost estimate & budget sign-off. Renewal risk: billing approvals take ~6 weeks at HC; if pilot extends beyond that risk of pause.

Theo (Customer Eng): Enablement plan: 1x 45m workshop (API + auth) and 1x 30m ops review. Suggest recording workshop and adding short checklist in workspace.

Sam Wu (HarborCare): Sam here. We'll provide Okta app config and a staging subnet. Prefer Wed afternoon PT for meetings. Also please confirm data retention default and whether logs can be pseudonymized.

Lena (CS): Data retention: by default 30 days for pilot, can configure per-customer. We support pseudonymization via token masking. I'll share the doc.

Diego (Solutions): Tech tasks: request SCIM creds, provide ACS/EntityID for SAML, open firewall rule for egress to Redwood IPs. Example we ask for: ```tcp 443 to 198.51.100.0/24```

Priyanka (PM): Timeline draft: Week 0 (this week)  auth + infra; Week 1  pilot integration; Week 2  eval + ops handoff; Week 3  scale & commercial check. If procurement not started by day 10 we escalate.

Onboard Bot: Workspace "harborcare-pilot" created: https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/harborcare-pilot. Access granted to Lena, Diego, Priyanka, Theo.

Nora Patel (HarborCare): Confirming Okta app config and staging subnet will be ready Tue EOD. Procurement contact is @Marta (legal). We'll loop Marta once we have SOW.

Theo (Customer Eng): For evaluation, let's pick 12 representative prompts and an automated harness. Pass threshold: mean utility >=0.7 and no critical safety flags. I'll draft harness and upload.

Lena (CS): Action items: Diego  prepare network/firewall template; Theo  upload evaluation harness; Priyanka  draft SOW & success checklist; Lena  schedule Wed 2pm PT workshop and share data retention doc. Nora/Sam: share Okta metadata + staging subnet by Tue EOD.

Sam Wu (HarborCare): Noted. Wed 2pm PT works. We'll send Okta metadata by Tue.

Priyanka (PM): Procurement note: to mitigate renewal risk, propose a conditional PO milestone at day 21 to lock pricing. I'll include that in SOW draft.

Diego (Solutions): Also recommend a canary plan: start pilot on 1 service region, monitor p95 and error-rate, then expand. If p95 >350ms or error-rate >2% for 1 hour, automatically rollback traffic.

Lena (CS): Good call. I'll add rollback criteria to the runbook.

Onboard Bot: Added runbook template to workspace under /runbooks/harborcare-runbook.md.

Theo (Customer Eng): I'll prepare short survey for pilot users to capture qualitative feedback after first session.

Lena (CS): OK closing notes: I'll post meeting invite + links and circulate the SOW draft when ready. If anyone sees blockers before Tue EOD flag them here. Thanks everyone.
